title: The AI Economist: Optimal Economic Policy Design via Two-level Deep Reinforcement Learning
reasoning: The paper focuses on economic policy design and deep reinforcement learning. While it utilizes objective functions based on utilitarian social welfare and equality, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or moral/ethical reasoning. Its 'Ethics' section (Section 9) discusses the risks and limitations of the simulation tool rather than providing a benchmark for morals or ethics.
